findings.boundary: Replay of saved tool shapes through the presenter; original provider request bodies are not reconstructed.

findings.mechanism: SDK 8000-character tool-result clipping precedes custom context presentation
findings.treatment: Separate structured metadata and diagnostics into typed SDK text parts; no validation claims are altered.

limits: Local exact receipt transport is not model use or task success.
Detached diagnostic text is excluded from evidence parsing.
Metadata larger than an individual SDK text-part budget can still be unavailable; malformed or clipped metadata is unknown.
The long-output case forwards more bytes after retaining metadata; no token/cost improvement is claimed.
Batch reads and literal compiler repair are separate factors; task selection predates model dispatch.
